question: Why does Bhairava commend the goddess for asking about a matter rare even for the gods?
premises: Bhairava expresses strong approval of the question
He states that he has been asked
The subject asked about is difficult for even the gods to obtain
inference: The goddess has asked about a matter so profound that it is rare even among the gods
plain_english: Well said, well said, O great goddess. You have asked me about something hard to obtain even for the gods.
